data_fields.name: uploadsPerFrame
data_fields.donor_constant: at most one sub-image upload per bind when dirty

best_idea: Pack the HUD's small glyphs or icons into a shelf atlas with one pixel of padding, and upload only the changed rectangle once per frame, not one upload per label.
decision_why: The shelf packer and the one-upload-per-frame rule suit HUD labels that spawn in bursts (damage numbers, nameplates); the donor's full-width upload, off-by-one and unsafe buffer type are fixed in the sketch, and the missing second page is added before the atlas is used in a fight.
acceptance: In a fight test with 40 damage numbers spawned in one frame, the HUD issues at most one texture upload that frame and its rectangle covers only the new glyph rows (upload count 1, dirty box as expected); when the current page is full, a new page opens instead of an exception.
